# check/unreachable

> Unreachable code: unreachable stops the program if it is ever run.

truck [check](../check.md) · [source](../../../registry/check/unreachable.pkg)

```
match op
case ADD
  return a + b
case SUB
  return a - b
end
unreachable "unknown operator"
```

Writes the position and any messages to stderr and exits with status 2:

```
calc.pkg:20:3: unreachable code was reached: unknown operator
```

`unreachable` alone has no message; with messages (`str` expressions, separated
by commas) it is [check/unreachable_msg](unreachable_msg.md). It is not turned off by
`nocheck`.

## Syntax

Kind: `statement`

```
unreachable
```

## Needs

- [std/exprstmt](../std/exprstmt.md)
- [check/fail](fail.md)

## Expands to

This package has no backend: each use is rewritten to the following
source, with `{slot}` replaced by what was written there, and compiled again.

```
check_fail({@pos}, "unreachable code was reached", "")
check_stop()
```
